description: View resolution example — REPLACE VIEW with JOIN to view
source_sql: REPLACE VIEW l_bcs_loaddb.prior_cycle_v AS SELECT ctcp.NBR_CARDH_ACCT AS Account_Number, ctcp.AMT_CRED_LMT AS Credit_Limit, ctcp.AMT_MIN_PYMT_DUE AS Minimum_Payment_Due FROM s_trmfdb.ctcp WHERE CSUM(1, ctcp.NBR_CARDH_ACCT, ctcp.TIME_LAST_UPD DESC) = 1;

SELECT ma.account_id, ma.account_name, pc.Credit_Limit, pc.Minimum_Payment_Due FROM e_mortgage_db.mortgage_account ma LEFT JOIN l_bcs_loaddb.prior_cycle_v pc ON ma.account_id = pc.Account_Number WHERE ma.active = '1';
